jobMapping.description: [Deprecated] Mapping of JobIDs to node selectors for pod scheduling

^[0-9]+$.description: Node selector configuration for a specific JobID. Each property represents a Kubernetes node label (key-value pair).

additionalProperties.description: The value for a node label. Must follow Kubernetes label value format (RFC 1123).

propertyNames.description: Node label key. Must follow Kubernetes label key format (RFC 1123 DNS subdomain).

jobProfiles.description: Scheduling and index-storage profiles keyed by JobID. Profile "0" is the default every job inherits; a JobID profile is deep-merged over it field by field.

indexStorage.description: Index volume settings for this profile. Under profile "0" these are the chart-wide defaults; under any other JobID they are overrides deep-merged over profile 0.

mode.description: 'pvc' provisions one PVC per JobID (olake-index-<JobID>); 'none' disables the index volume.

size.description: Requested volume size, e.g. 50Gi. Grow-only; Kubernetes rejects shrinking.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for the index PVC. Empty falls back to global.storageClass, then the cluster default. Must be block storage.

accessModes.description: Access modes for the index PVC.

mountPath.description: Mount path inside the connector container.

cacheSizeMB.description: Pebble block cache size in megabytes, passed to the connector as OLAKE_INDEX_DB_CACHE_SIZE. Resident memory inside the connector pod.

maxOpenFiles.description: Maximum SSTable file descriptors Pebble keeps open, passed to the connector as OLAKE_INDEX_DB_MAX_OPEN_FILES.

labels.description: Labels merged into the index PVC. These override the worker's app.kubernetes.io/* defaults; only olake.io/job-id is reserved. Merged per key with profile 0 rather than replacing it.

annotations.description: Annotations applied to the index PVC, for backup tooling and similar. Merged per key with profile 0 rather than replacing it.

existingClaim.description: Name of an existing PVC to mount instead of provisioning one. Only honoured on a specific JobID profile, never on profile 0. When set, size, storageClass, accessModes, labels and annotations are ignored for that job.
